title: ezgoggles map
description: The project map, written for members to read and understand. The original course materials stay in docs/. A translation (goggles-data/translations/map.<language>.json) uses the same schema and also sets `source`.

language.description: Language of the text in this file, for example zh or en.

source.description: Translations only: the fingerprint of the map.json they translate. `ezgoggles check` prints it.

goal.description: One sentence: what the project makes.

requirements.description: The task layer: what the course asks for. Key points only.

sources.description: Paths of the original course materials, relative to the project root.

deliver.description: What the group hands in, one item per deliverable. A presentation or a defense is a deliverable too.

text.description: A short noun phrase: what to hand in.

due.description: Deadline as YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM. Leave it out if there is none.

from.description: Ids of the stages whose output goes directly into this deliverable. Earlier stages are found through `next`.

grading.description: How the work is graded, with weights.

notes.description: Other rules that a member must not miss.

stages.description: The solution layer: how the group solves the task, as a data flow. Cut stages where the data changes form, not by assignment parts and not by script files. Each stage is also one direction that a member can take.

id.description: ASCII id. Used in branch names: <name>/<id>.

name.description: Short human name of the stage.

does.description: One short sentence: what this stage does.

path.description: Directory of this stage, relative to the project root. It links the stage to its code, and it limits what an agent changes. The TUI shows it only in learning mode.

input.description: A short noun phrase: what this stage takes in.

output.description: A short noun phrase: what this stage gives out.

next.description: Ids of the stages that take this stage's output. Empty for the last stage.
